# UNBOUND

> UNBOUND is a founder-led agency for PR, growth strategy, social media, ATL, BTL and events. One team and one story across every channel a brand touches.

UNBOUND was founded by Himani Sharma and Amisha Sethi, and is based in India. Brands work with UNBOUND through a monthly brand partnership or a fixed-scope campaign or launch. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute brand session with both founders, followed by a written plan with the price within three working days.

## Services

- PR and reputation: media relations, press launches, founder profiling, crisis communication, reputation management, awards.
- Growth strategy: brand positioning, go-to-market, audience insight, channel planning, partnerships, measurement.
- Social media: social strategy, content and reels, creators and influencers, community management, paid social, LinkedIn for leaders.
- ATL campaigns: campaign ideas, TV and digital film, print, radio, outdoor, media planning and buying.
- BTL activations: on-ground activations, retail and in-store, sampling, mall and campus programmes, experiential, trade marketing.
- Events: product launches, conferences, brand experiences, executive dinners, exhibitions, event PR and content.
